title: Have You Done Military Training?
synopsis: In September each year, new students in schools around China must participate in mandatory military training.

fullText.simplified:
你军训了吗？

    “一二一、一二一”，“向左转、向右转”……每年的9月，你都可以听到这样的叫喊声在校园里此起彼伏。是的，这就是军训。
    军训是新生入学的必经之路。每年9月是开学季，学生们走进新的校园，他们首先要进行的就是军训。初中、高中的军训一般持续一周，大学的军训一般是半个月到一个月。不同的学校有不同的军训地点。有的学校要去军营，真实体验军营生活；有的学校则在学校，以操场为训练场进行军训。在军训期间，学生们需要穿上迷彩服，从站军姿开始练习。正步走、军体拳、射击等都是军训中的学习内容。
    军训很辛苦，每天起早贪黑，在烈日下高强度的训练让许多学生叫苦连连。但这正是军训的目的，因为军训就是为了让学生们增强体质，遇到困难勇于挑战，养成坚韧不拔的意志品质。
fullText.traditional:
你軍訓了嗎？

    “一二一、一二一”，“向左轉、向右轉”……每年的9月，你都可以聽到這樣的叫喊聲在校園裡此起彼伏。是的，這就是軍訓。
    軍訓是新生入學的必經之路。每年9月是開學季，學生們走進新的校園，他們首先要進行的就是軍訓。初中、高中的軍訓一般持續一週，大學的軍訓一般是半個月到一個月。不同的學校有不同的軍訓地點。有的學校要去軍營，真實體驗軍營生活；有的學校則在學校，以操場為訓練場進行軍訓。在軍訓期間，學生們需要穿上迷彩服，從站軍姿開始練習。正步走、軍體拳、射擊等都是軍訓中的學習內容。
    軍訓很辛苦，每天起早貪黑，在烈日下高強度的訓練讓許多學生叫苦連連。但這正是軍訓的目的，因為軍訓就是為了讓學生們增強體質，遇到困難勇於挑戰，養成堅韌不拔的意志品質。

raw.synopsis: In September each year, new students in schools around China must participate in mandatory military training.
sentence_translations: “One Two One, One Two One”, “Turn left, Turn right”…
Each year in September you can hear shouts like these all around campus.
That's right: this is military training.
Military training is the path that all freshmen must take at school start.
The new semester starts in September each year.
As students enter the new school, the first thing they must do is to participate in the military training.
In junior and senior high school, this process lasts about a week; in college, it’s often one half to one month.
Different schools use different locations for military training.
At some schools they go to military camps to let the students experience real military life.
But at other schools they stay within the school and use the sports field as a training ground.
During military training, students must put on military fatigues, and start their learning from the military posture.
Goose-stepping, military boxing, and shooting are all practiced during the military training.
Military training is tiring work. Every day the students have to get up early and return back late.
The intense training under the burning sun makes many students agonized.
However, this is precisely the goal of military training, since it is designed to enhance the students' physical capabilities, ..
.. to teach the students to challenge difficulties, and to cultivate strong wills.
